full_judgment: 10. Defendant No. 2 filed Ext. M series which are the municipal rent receipts issued in favour of Motilal and Md. Golam Muksud. Ext. N series are the rent receipts which show that Motilal paid rent to the Government. Ext. P series.are the khatian showing the names of Golam Muksud and Suruzzaman. Ext. Q and Q(1) are the duplicate carbon copies showing payment of rent. Ext. I is the certificate of delivery of possession in respect of Income Tax Certificate case No. 141 of 1952-53. Ext. K is the sale certificate issued in the aforesaid Certificate case. Ext. 0 series are the certified copies of the deeds of sale by which the defendant No. 2 Haji Md. Suruzzaman and Master Golam Muksud purchased the land from Motilal. These are the documentary evidence which are marked Exts. in this case.
